## ForceConnect 2.3 — a proper server table, and updates that tell you

ForceConnect 2.3 turns the **Servers** screen into a sortable table, lets you **remove the default servers you never use** (and get them back whenever you like), and now **tells you when a new version is out**.

> Already on 2.1.2 or later? This update installs from inside the app: click **Update now** when ForceConnect offers it. Coming from 2.1.1 or earlier, install it by hand once, and later updates arrive by themselves after that.

### ✨ What's new

- **Servers as a table** — name, address, protocols and latency on one line each. Sort by name or by latency, tick rows to select several, and see at a glance which server is in use. Latency shows as a bar, so the fast ones stand out.
- **Remove default servers** — remove one from its row or tick several and remove them together. An **Undo** appears right after, and servers you added yourself ask for confirmation first, since they can't be brought back.
- **Restore defaults** — one button brings every removed server back and refreshes the default list from GitHub, so new providers show up without waiting for a release. Offline, it restores from the copy on your computer and says so.
- **Update popup** — when a new version is out, ForceConnect says so with a short list of what changed. Choose **Update now**, **Later** (until the next launch) or **Skip this version**. It checks at startup and every few hours while the app stays open, and never installs anything without your click.
- **Filters match what you have** — the protocol filters and favourites count follow the servers you actually have, so removing the last DoQ server doesn't leave an empty DoQ filter behind.

### 📥 Download

| Platform         | File                                                              | Requirements                                        |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| **Windows**      | `ForceConnect_2.3.0_x64-setup.exe`                                | Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or later, x64 |
| **macOS** (beta) | `ForceConnect_2.3.0_universal.dmg`                                | macOS 10.15 or later, Apple Silicon or Intel        |
| **Linux** (beta) | `.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu), `.rpm` (Fedora, openSUSE) or `.AppImage` | NetworkManager or systemd-resolved, and polkit      |

### ⚠️ Good to know

- **Windows SmartScreen** may warn that the installer is from an unrecognized publisher, because it isn't code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS and Linux are still in beta.** On macOS, right-click ForceConnect and choose **Open** the first time you launch it, because the app isn't notarized yet. Please [report how it goes](https://github.com/Mxqius/ForceConnect/issues/new).

### 🐞 Feedback

Found a bug or want a DNS provider added? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Mxqius/ForceConnect/issues). Adding a provider needs no Rust — just edit [`servers.json`](https://github.com/Mxqius/ForceConnect/blob/main/src-tauri/crates/dns/servers.json).
